survivorship_caveat: Membership is TODAY's membership. Any back-test run over past years using this list is biased upward, because companies that fell out of the index (or failed) are absent from it. Treat every result built on it as an OPTIMISTIC bound, and mark it down (S4 carries the survivorship mark-down).
